description:
# DiscordWebhookAPI-PNX
Send Discord webhook messages from [PowerNukkitX](https://github.com/PowerNukkitX/PowerNukkitX) plugins.

Inspired by [CortexPE/DiscordWebhookAPI](https://github.com/CortexPE/DiscordWebhookAPI) for PocketMine-MP.

## Installation and setup
Place `DiscordWebhookAPI-PNX.jar` in your server's `plugins/` folder.

> [!NOTE]
> You must declare DiscordWebhookAPI-PNX as a dependency before you can use it.
> ```yaml
> # in plugin.yml:
> depend: [DiscordWebhookAPI-PNX]
> ```

## Send a message

```java
Webhook webhook = new Webhook("https://discord.com/api/webhooks/...");

Message message = new Message()
        .content("Hello from PowerNukkitX!");

webhook.send(message);
```

## Override username and avatar

```java
Message message = new Message()
        .content("Server is online.")
        .username("MyServer")
        .avatarUrl("https://example.com/avatar.png");

webhook.send(message);
```

## Handle the response

`send()` is asynchronous and does not block the main thread.
Pass a callback to act on the response — it runs back on the main thread.

```java
webhook.send(message, response -> {
    if (response.isSuccess()) {
        getLogger().info("Webhook sent! Status: " + response.statusCode());
    } else {
        getLogger().warning("Webhook failed: " + response.statusCode() + " " + response.body());
    }
});
```

## Embeds

```java
Embed embed = new Embed()
        .title("Player joined")
        .description("**Steve** joined the server.")
        .color(0x57F287)
        .timestamp();

Message message = new Message().addEmbed(embed);
webhook.send(message);
```

### Full embed example

```java
Embed embed = new Embed()
        .author("Steve", null, "https://example.com/steve.png")
        .title("Achievement unlocked")
        .description("Steve just got **Taking Inventory**!")
        .url("https://minecraft.wiki/w/Achievements")
        .color(255, 215, 0)
        .thumbnail("https://example.com/thumbnail.png")
        .image("https://example.com/banner.png")
        .field("Server", "Survival", true)
        .field("World", "Overworld", true)
        .footer("PowerNukkitX", "https://example.com/icon.png")
        .timestamp();

webhook.send(new Message().addEmbed(embed));
```

### Multiple embeds

```java
Message message = new Message()
        .addEmbed(new Embed().title("Embed 1").color(0xFF0000))
        .addEmbed(new Embed().title("Embed 2").color(0x00FF00));

webhook.send(message);
```

## API reference

### `Webhook`
| Method | Description |
|---|---|
| `new Webhook(url)` | Create a webhook instance |
| `send(message)` | Send asynchronously, no callback |
| `send(message, callback)` | Send asynchronously, callback on main thread |
| `getUrl()` | Returns the webhook URL |

### `Message`
All methods return `this` for chaining.

| Method | Description |
|---|---|
| `content(text)` | Plain text message |
| `username(name)` | Override the webhook display name |
| `avatarUrl(url)` | Override the webhook avatar |
| `tts(bool)` | Enable text-to-speech |
| `addEmbed(embed)` | Attach an embed |

### `Embed`
All methods return `this` for chaining.

| Method | Description |
|---|---|
| `title(text)` | Embed title |
| `description(text)` | Embed description |
| `url(url)` | Clickable link on the title |
| `color(int)` | Hex color, e.g. `0xFF5733` |
| `color(r, g, b)` | RGB color |
| `author(name)` | Author name only |
| `author(name, url, iconUrl)` | Author with link and icon |
| `field(name, value)` | Add a field |
| `field(name, value, inline)` | Add an inline field |
| `thumbnail(url)` | Small image top-right |
| `image(url)` | Large image at the bottom |
| `footer(text)` | Footer text |
| `footer(text, iconUrl)` | Footer with icon |
| `timestamp()` | Current time |
| `timestamp(instant)` | Custom `java.time.Instant` |

### `WebhookResponse`
| Method | Description |
|---|---|
| `statusCode()` | HTTP status code (`204` = success, `-1` = connection error) |
| `body()` | Response body string |
| `isSuccess()` | `true` if status is 2xx |
